# pvecli cluster join

Make a standalone node join the cluster of the current profile.

```text
pvecli cluster join [TARGET] [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `TARGET` | Address of the standalone node that will join. |

## Options

| Option | Default | Description |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `--target-user VALUE` | `root@pam` | API user on the joining node. |
| `--target-password-env VALUE` |  | Env var holding the joining node's password. |
| `--peer-password-env VALUE` |  | Env var holding the cluster's root password. |
| `--link0 VALUE` |  | Address of the joining node on corosync link 0. |
| `--link1 VALUE` |  | Address on corosync link 1. |
| `-y`, `--yes` |  | Skip the typed confirmation. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` |  | Profile of the cluster to join. |
